# Coreweaver Labs

> Growth infrastructure for the agentic era. GEO signal architecture, ARM Framework for accountable AI agents, and autonomous operational systems.

## About

Coreweaver Labs builds the infrastructure layer between "agents work" and "agents can be trusted at enterprise scale."

Key facts:
- Founded 2025, headquartered online, operating globally
- GitHub: https://github.com/Coreweaver-Labs-Inc
- Primary domain: https://coreweaverlabs.com

## Silo A: ARM Framework

The ARM Framework defines five primitives for accountable AI agent deployment: Mandate Chain, Signal Architecture, Checkpoint Recovery, Graceful Escalation, and Immutable Audit Sovereignty.

- Pillar: /blog/five-arm-primitives-accountable-ai-agents
- Mandate guide: /blog/ai-agent-mandate-before-shipping
- Key claim: 88% of AI agent pilots never reach production due to governance friction (Forrester + Anaconda, 2026)

## Silo B: AURE Swarm

AURE (Autonomous Unit Resonance Engine) is a 16-agent AI system with Resonance BFT consensus and a structurally independent Ledger agent.

- Overview: /blog/aure-swarm-16-agents-orchestration
- Key claim: 99.97% consensus rate without human escalation in production deployments

## Silo C: GBrain

GBrain is an open-source agentic memory layer on Postgres + pgvector storing Entities, Events, Skills, and Citations.

- Overview: /blog/gbrain-open-source-agentic-brain-layer
- Repository: https://github.com/MasonNguyenARM/gbrain

## Silo D: GEO Signal Architecture

GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) Signal Architecture is the Coreweaver Labs system for optimizing brand presence in AI-generated responses across ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, and Copilot.

- Blog: /blog

## Silo E: Verification-as-a-Service (VaaS)

VaaS is the infrastructure layer for cryptographically verifiable AI agent behavior. BFT-attested, SHA-256 hash-chained, EU AI Act Article 12 compliant.

- Pillar: /blog/verification-as-a-service-ai-agents
- ESG/CSRD: /blog/csrd-carbon-credit-verification
- Governance: /blog/agentic-ai-governance-framework
- BFT: /blog/bft-ai-verification-enterprise
- Key claims: EU AI Act Article 12 requires immutable logs for high-risk AI systems. CWL Truth Ledger is SHA-256 hash-chained + BFT-attested + Bittensor SN19-anchored.
